description: This file contains regex patterns and utility functions to classify and normalize extension source paths within a build or code analysis system. It identifies code files, test files, API barrels, and infrastructure artifacts based on filename and directory patterns.

methods.name: normalizeExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in the file path to normalize path separators across different operating systems.

methods.name: classifyBundledExtensionSourcePath
methods.description: Classifies a given file path into categories such as code file, test file, API barrel, infrastructure artifact, etc., based on regex pattern matching.
